name: Good day
ingredients_raw: WHEAT FLOUR, VEGETABLE FAT (PALM), SUGAR, CASHEW BITS (1.8%), INVERT SUGAR, WHOLE MILK POWDER, BUTTER (MILK) (0.7%) RAISING AGENTS (AMMONIUM BICARBONATE & SODIUM BICARBONATE), SALT, EMULSIFIERS (SOY LECITHIN, MONO & DIGLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS (PALM) & DIACETYL TARTARIC ACID ESTERS OF MONO & DIGLYCERIDES (PALM), FLAVOURINGS. CONTAINS WHEAT (GLUTEN), MILK, CASHEW & SOY MANUFACTURED IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO PROCESSES EGG & TREE NUTS (ALMOND, PISTACHIO).
